rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a holiday destination with accommodation and leisure facilities.

example.english: The resort we went to last time had a pool and water activities.
example.traditional: 我哋上次去嗰間度假村，有泳池又有水上活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng5 ci3 heoi3 go2 gaan1 dou6 gaa3 cyun1 jau5 wing6 ci4 jau6 jau5 seoi2 soeng6 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a way out or an available means of dealing with a difficult situation, rather than specifically a final option.

example.english: We owe so much money; we need to find another resort, another way out.
example.traditional: 欠咗咁多錢，我哋要搵吓有冇其他出路。
example.jyutping: him3 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 haa5 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 ceot1 lou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the recourse is the final option available.

example.english: If there’s really no other way, I’ll use this as a last resort.
example.traditional: 如果真係冇辦法，我先會用呢招做最後手段。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3 ngo5 sin1 wui5 jung6 ni1 ziu1 zou6 zeoi3 hau6 sau2 dyun6

rows.note: Use this for a physical refuge or shelter where someone can seek safety.

example.english: During a typhoon, this sports centre will serve as a resort for people seeking shelter.
example.traditional: 打風嗰陣，呢個體育館會開放做避難所。
example.jyutping: daa2 fung1 go2 zan6 ni1 go3 tai2 juk6 gun2 wui5 hoi1 fong3 zou6 bei6 naan6 so2
